title: Sky Guard
blurb: Drag the shield, shove the sky aside, keep the balloon alive.

title: Sneaky Steps
blurb: Just walk to the door. The room has other plans.

title: Bubble Pop
blurb: Aim, bank off the walls, pop clusters of three or more.

title: Fruit Merge
blurb: Drop fruit into the jar. Two of a kind merge into something bigger.

title: Pour Me
blurb: Draw one line, guide the water, fill the glass to the line.

title: Save the Pet
blurb: Draw one line to shield your pet. The bees are coming!
Slide the tiles, match the numbers, chase the 2048 tile.

title: Sudoku
blurb: Classic 9×9 with notes, hints and three lives.

title: Skip Arrow
blurb: Tap an arrow to send it off the board. Only a clear lane lets it go.

title: Dot Trails
blurb: Join each pair of dots with a trail. Trails never cross, and every square must be filled.

title: Paint Path
blurb: Paint every block. Each colour draws one line from its ring, and tinted blocks take only their own colour.

title: Honk & Go
blurb: Empty the car park. Tap a car to drive it out, forwards or in reverse, whichever way is clear.

title: Brick Volley
blurb: Aim, fire a volley of balls and knock the numbered bricks down before they reach the floor.

title: Bucket Blast
blurb: Hold fire, steer the stream with the green pieces, and fill every bucket before the cannon runs dry.

title: Spin & Stick
blurb: Tap to throw knives into the spinning target. Hit a knife already in it and you are out.

title: Snip & Snack
blurb: Swipe to snip the ropes and drop the berry into the hungry chick. Catch every firefly on the way.

title: Rev & Roll
blurb: Hold gas to climb, tip back in the air, grab the fuel. How far can you drive before it runs out?

title: Duck & Weave
blurb: Missiles are on your tail. Weave through the sky and lure them into each other.

title: Sortiva
blurb: Pour colours between tubes until each holds just one. 600 levels, every one proved solvable.

title: Tumble Blocks
blurb: Drag blocks onto the board. Fill a row or column to clear it.

title: Pair Match
blurb: Flip two cards, remember everything, clear the board.

title: Tune Recall
blurb: Watch, listen, repeat. The tune grows every round.
